dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, arising in the left axillary lymph node (excisional biopsy 2026-08-25; diagnosis unchanged by FISH addendum 2026-09-08). Non-germinal-center (ABC-like) phenotype by Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Cell of origin is by IHC only; gene expression profiling (for example Lymph2Cx) was not done and would not change first-line choice.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: This is a new lymphoma and not a recurrence of the 2016 ER-positive breast carcinoma: lesional cells are CD20 positive, with CK AE1/AE3 and GATA3 negative and no carcinoma morphology.

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIIB (Lugano 2014). Disease is above and below the diaphragm

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: Spleen with focal nodules is nodal-type involvement, so stage III; stage IV would apply only if radiology read the splenic disease as extranodal organ involvement

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present: fever of 38.0 C or higher on several days (maximum 38.4 C) and drenching night sweats

stage_bulk_definition.quote: Bulky disease: mesenteric conglomerate 7.5 x 5.1 cm (SUVmax 22.3).

mn_stage_iv.quote: Spleen with focal nodules is nodal-type involvement, so stage III; stage IV would apply only if radiology read the splenic disease as extranodal organ involvement

mol_del_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor by IHC: MYC 45% (cutoff 40%) and BCL2 70% (cutoff 50%). Ki-67 about 80%.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: Interphase FISH shows no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement, so this does not meet WHO 2022 criteria for high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangement (no double-hit or triple-hit).

mn_da_epoch.quote: The double-expressor phenotype is an adverse marker but, without rearrangement, does not by itself change the standard regimen or justify DA-EPOCH-R.

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI is lower (about 2-3) because it does not weight age 59 or the splenic disease the same way.

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI intermediate by my estimate (verify with the calculator). Elevated LDH and stage III contribute.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no lumbar puncture and no CNS prophylaxis (high-dose methotrexate or intrathecal) now.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no lumbar puncture and no CNS prophylaxis (high-dose methotrexate or intrathecal) now.

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: I would not give full-dose R-CHOP or Pola-R-CHP in this setting.

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: Gates before cycle 1, with the aim of starting within about 2-3 weeks: cardio-oncology agreement; repeat echocardiogram after 2-3 weeks of guideline-directed therapy showing LVEF 45% or higher

tx_cardioprotection.quote: start guideline-directed therapy now rather than waiting for the echo: an ARNI or ACE inhibitor/ARB, an evidence-based beta-blocker (carvedilol or metoprolol succinate)

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: Cycles 5-6 are anthracycline-free: rituximab, cyclophosphamide, vincristine and prednisone, with polatuzumab if tolerated.

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: use an anthracycline-free regimen (R-CVP-based, with polatuzumab if the team agrees) or refer to a clinical trial, accepting a lower expected cure rate.

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: Cardiac monitoring: troponin and NT-proBNP with each cycle, ECG, and echocardiogram with GLS before cycle 1, after cycle 4 (before the anthracycline-free cycles), and at the end of treatment.

mn_non_curative.quote: Curative-intent immunochemotherapy: Pola-R-CHP every 21 days for 6 cycles, with a doxorubicin ceiling.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT about 3-4 weeks after cycle 6, scored by Deauville per Lugano 2014.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis: intermediate risk (LDH about 2x ULN, bulk 7.5 cm); allopurinol or febuxostat, and modest hydration given the LVEF.

sup_gcsf.quote: Febrile neutropenia prophylaxis: pegfilgrastim or biosimilar each cycle, given age, cardiac comorbidity and the intermediate risk of this regimen.

sup_anastrozole.quote: Anastrozole: continue to the planned completion in November 2026; it is not affected by the lymphoma and has no major interaction with the regimen; the breast team should confirm.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B: HBsAg and anti-HBc negative, so no antiviral prophylaxis is needed; anti-HBs negative, so offer hepatitis B vaccination

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: She is fit for curative-intent immunochemotherapy by age, ECOG 1, and normal renal, hepatic and marrow reserve. Her goal is cure and a return to work at the school library, and this plan is consistent with that.

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: ECG, high-sensitivity troponin, NT-proBNP, ischemia evaluation and cardiac MRI: none documented. Cardio-oncology consult not documented.
